toast_game_deleted: Game deleted. Click Undo to restore it.
toast_games_deleted_one: {count} game deleted. Click Undo to restore it.
toast_games_deleted_other: {count} games deleted. Click Undo to restore them.
toast_epic_logged_in: Logged in to Epic Games as {name}.
error_title_required: Enter a title for the game.
error_load_failed: Your saved data was not loaded ({error}). Nothing will be saved until Spotter restarts and loads it.
error_not_loaded: your saved data was not loaded, so changes are not saved
error_login_expired: Your login has expired. Please log in again.
error_steam_setup: Steam needs your Steam ID and an API key. Log in to get your ID, then enter your API key.
error_steam_timeout: The Steam login timed out after 2 minutes. Please try again.
error_steam_signature: Steam could not confirm that this login came from Steam. Please try again.
error_gog_code: Paste the address or the code the browser shows after you sign in.
error_epic_code: Paste the JSON response or the authorization code the browser shows.
error_xbox_key: Xbox needs an OpenXBL API key. Get a free one at xbl.io and enter it on the Import page.
error_psn_token: PlayStation needs your NPSSO token. Get it from the PlayStation website.
error_psn_expired: PlayStation did not accept the NPSSO token. It may have expired: get a new one.
delete_undo_hint: You will have 8 seconds to undo.
library_subtitle: Track your games across all platforms
library_search: Search by title, genre, tag or note...
onboarding_text: Import your games from Steam, GOG, Epic, Xbox or PlayStation, or add them by hand.
add_subtitle: Add a game to your library by hand
stats_subtitle: An overview of your time with games
stats_no_playtime: No playtime recorded yet. Import games to start tracking.
stats_estimated: Estimated from the games you are playing: no playtime has been recorded yet.
profile_platform_note: {platform}: set up on the Import page
profile_no_keyring: No system keyring is available: platform tokens are stored unencrypted in Spotter's configuration folder.
profile_backup_found: Backup file found. Importing it merges it with your current library.
profile_backup_missing: No backup file yet. Export first to create one.
import_subtitle: Bring in your game library from Steam, GOG and more
import_steam_opening: Opening the Steam login in your browser...
import_epic_scan: Looking for games installed with the Epic Games Launcher...
import_waiting_login: Waiting for you to log in...
import_gog_hint: After signing in, copy the address of the page you land on.
import_epic_optional: Optional: without logging in, only installed games are found.
import_epic_hint: Copy the JSON response (or the authorization code) the browser page shows.
import_epic_placeholder: Paste the JSON or the authorization code here
import_epic_full_note: Imports every game your Epic account owns.
import_epic_local_note: Only installed games. Log in to import the whole library.
import_xbox_key_placeholder: Your OpenXBL API key, from xbl.io
import_xbox_key_link: Get a free API key at xbl.io
import_nintendo_no_api: Nintendo offers no public API for game libraries.
import_nintendo_manual: Add your Nintendo games by hand on the Add game page.
import_tip_steam: Log in to get your ID, then enter your API key from steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey.
import_tip_gog: Click Log in, sign in, then paste the address you land on.
import_tip_epic: Log in to import the whole library, or import the installed games only.
import_tip_xbox: Get a free API key at xbl.io, enter it above, then import.
import_tip_playstation: Get your NPSSO token at ca.account.sony.com and enter it above.
import_tip_nintendo: No API: add games by hand on the Add game page.
import_note_reimport: Importing again updates the games you have and adds the new ones, without duplicates.
import_note_covers: Covers are downloaded after an import, unless you turned that off in Preferences.
import_note_backups: You can export and import JSON backups on the Profile page.
steam_callback_ok_text: Spotter has your Steam ID. You can close this tab and go back to Spotter.
steam_callback_failed_text: Steam could not confirm the login. Please try again.
preferences_library_desc: How games are added, sorted and shown.
preferences_imports_desc: What happens after a library import.
preferences_language_desc: The language of Spotter's interface. Game titles and descriptions stay as the platforms send them.
preferences_language_choice_desc: Follows the system until you pick one.
preferences_startup_desc: What Spotter shows when it opens.
preferences_notifications_desc: The short messages at the bottom of the window that confirm an action.
preferences_show_notifications_desc: Confirm finished actions. Errors always show.
preferences_toast_duration_desc: How long a notification stays on screen.
preferences_dates_desc: How dates are written across Spotter.
preferences_date_format_desc: Release dates, last played and achievement unlocks.
preferences_layout_desc: How much room the sidebar and the library list take.
preferences_sidebar_width_desc: Room for the navigation on the left.
preferences_compact_list_desc: Less space between games, so more of them fit on screen.
preferences_show_covers_desc: Show each game's cover next to its title.
preferences_colour_cues_desc: Information that would otherwise rest on colour alone.
preferences_status_labels_desc: Write each game's status next to it instead of a coloured dot.
preferences_navigation_desc: How easy buttons are to hit.
preferences_large_targets_desc: Taller buttons and chips, easier to click.
preferences_new_games_desc: What a game you add by hand starts with.
preferences_preselected_desc: Already picked when you add a game by hand.
preferences_sorting_desc: How the library is ordered when Spotter opens.
preferences_sort_order_desc: Also changes when you pick another order in the library.
preferences_remember_filters_desc: Keep the status and platform filters from one session to the next.
preferences_game_details_desc: What the library cards and the game pages show.
preferences_show_descriptions_desc: Show the start of each game's description on its card.
preferences_achievements_display_desc: How much of a game's achievements its page shows.
preferences_deleting_desc: A deleted game can be restored for 8 seconds.
preferences_confirm_delete_desc: Ask before a game leaves the library.
preferences_covers_desc: Cover images come from the platforms and are kept in Spotter's cache.
preferences_auto_covers_desc: Fetch the missing covers as soon as an import finishes.
